description: Workday & Holiday Calculator API: Calculate business days and SLA deadlines across 30+ countries including HU swap Saturdays. (Endpoint: POST /v1/workday-holiday/between)

end_date.description: Range end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (on or after start_date; max 3,660 days span).

include_end.description: Whether to include end_date in the evaluated range (default true).

include_start.description: Whether to include start_date in the evaluated range (default true).

start_date.description: Range start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: tinplate_workday_holiday
